title.en: Top 10 Most Common Atheist Arguments, and Why They Fail
title.el: Τα 10 πιο Κοινά Αθεϊστικά Επιχειρήματα και Γιατί Αποτυγχάνουν
title.ru: Топ-10 самых распространенных аргументов атеистов и почему они терпят неудачу

content.en:
### Top 10 Most Common Atheist Arguments

#### 1. There is no evidence for God’s existence.

What exactly does one mean by evidence? What is sufficient evidence for one person is often not sufficient for another. Nearly everything the Christian lays eyes on is proof of God’s existence because he sees the 'handiwork' of God all around him in creation. To produce material evidence for God is, ironically, to disprove a transcendent God and cast out faith.

#### 2. If God created the universe, who created God?

This argument fails to grasp what Christians understand as 'eternal.' God is the antecedent of all things and is eternal. If God had a Creator then His Creator would be God. God is God precisely because He does not have a creator.

#### 3. Believing in God is the same as believing in the Tooth Fairy.

This demonstration actually shows how different a belief in God is. The Judeo-Christian doctrine has thousands of years of testimony, martyrs, and historical corroboration. Tooth Fairy myths have none of these.

#### 4. The God of the Bible is evil because of suffering.

The fact that suffering exists is a strong argument, but the criticism itself takes for granted that good and evil are real ontological realities. If one accepts good and evil as realities, he is not in a position to fully reject God, but rather to wrestle with Him.
